questions.why: The new wage bill minus the old wage bill is £{answer}.

questions.q: A monopsonist pays the wage shown by the MCL curve.
questions.why: It pays the wage on the supply curve, which is lower.

questions.q: Which is a cause of imperfection in a labour market?
options: Workers don't know what other jobs pay
Wages are set by demand and supply
questions.why: Imperfect information stops workers moving to better jobs.

questions.q: Explain why the marginal cost of labour is above the wage for a monopsonist.

ideas.label: To hire one more worker, the firm must raise the wage
It must pay that higher wage to all its workers

questions.model: To hire one more worker the firm must raise the wage, and it pays that higher wage to all its workers. So the extra cost is the new wage plus the rise for everyone else.
questions.why: The extra cost includes the rise for everyone already there.

tests.answer: It must raise the wage to attract one more worker, and pay the higher wage to all its workers.
It must pay more to attract workers.
